attchmntText: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Limited has informed the Exchange about the Newspaper Publication of the unaudited and consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
sm_name: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Limited
voiceSummary: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting on November 12, 2026. The company published newspaper advertisements on November 13, 2026, in the Financial Express and Jansatta. The results are available on the BSE and NSE websites and the company website. R Systems International Limited issued a Postal Ballot Notice seeking shareholder approval for the remuneration of Mr. Nitesh Bansal as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer. The remote e-Voting commenced on November 13, 2026, and ends on December 12, 2026. Mr. Devesh Kumar Vasisht has been appointed as the Scrutinizer. Tarsons Products Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the half year and quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 12, 2026. Kerala Water Authority issued a public notice for tenders for the year 2026-27.

attchmntText: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Rectification of inadvertent typographical error in the Unaudited Financial Results submitted as part of the Outcome of the Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026'.
sm_name: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Limited
voiceSummary: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Limited submitted a rectification of an inadvertent typographical error in its Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Paid-up Equity Share Capital was corrected from 3,519.34 Lakhs to 3,639.34 Lakhs. The revision does not affect Earnings Per Share, profit, or any other financial figures. The revised results were approved by the Board of Directors on November 12, 2026. The company resubmitted the Outcome of the Board Meeting to BSE and NSE. The standalone profit for the half year ended September 30, 2026, was 986.31 Lakhs. Revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was 2,805.68 Lakhs. The Basic and Diluted Earnings Per Share for the quarter was 1.13 rupees. The independent auditor, SKGN & Associates LLP, expressed an unmodified conclusion on the reviewed results.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for quarter ended September 30, 2026.
sm_name: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Limited
voiceSummary: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The report was issued by Infomerics Valuation and Rating Limited. The company raised Rs. 90.00 crore through its Initial Public Offering. The monitoring agency confirmed there were no deviations from the objects disclosed in the offer document. Rs. 34.03 crore was spent till June 30, 2026. Rs. 16.62 crore was utilized during the quarter ending September 30, 2026. The statutory auditor is S K G N & Associates LLP. The company is an Indian fertility and women’s healthcare company. Promoters are Dr. Manika Khanna, Dr. Peeyush Khanna, and Vishad Khanna. The issue price was Rs. 79 per equity share. The report was submitted on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Limited has informed the Exchange regarding revised Code of Practices and Procedures for Fair Disclosure of Unpublished Price Sensitive Information pursuant to Regulation 8(2) of SEBI (PIT) Regulations, 2015.
sm_name: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Limited
voiceSummary: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a profit of 819.97 for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and 986.31 for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board appointed Dr. Ravish Manchanda as National Head – Operations Expansion & Strategy with effect from November 12, 2026. The Board approved a variation in IPO objects regarding the establishment of 19 new IVF centres, involving substitution of 6 cities and revision of the schedule, subject to shareholder approval via Postal Ballot. The amount of 5,000.00 Lakhs remains unchanged. The draft Postal Ballot notice will be sent to shareholders in due course. The Board also amended the policy on fair disclosure of unpublished price sensitive information.

attchmntText: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release on Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026."
sm_name: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Limited
voiceSummary: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported Q2 FY27 revenue of 37.4 crore rupees, an increase of 17.9 percent year-on-year. EBITDA for the quarter was 13.5 crore rupees with a margin of 36.0 percent. Profit after tax stood at 9.4 crore rupees, up 0.4 percent year-on-year. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue was 56.8 crore rupees, up 14.7 percent year-on-year. EBITDA was 15.9 crore rupees with a margin of 28.0 percent. Profit after tax was 11.2 crore rupees with a margin of 19.7 percent. The company commenced commercial operations at new hubs in South Extension and Gurgaon during the quarter. As of September 30, 2026, the company operates nine hubs and 28 spokes.
